name: getUserChatBoosts
description: Use this method to get the list of boosts added to a chat by a user. Requires administrator rights in the chat. Returns a [UserChatBoosts](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#userchatboosts) object.

parameters.name: chat_id
parameters.description: Unique identifier for the chat or username of the channel in the format `@username`

parameters.name: user_id
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the target user
